To help bridge that gap, I’ve put together a practical guide: “20 𝑺𝒆𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒕𝒔 𝒕𝒐 𝑶𝒑𝒕𝒊𝒎𝒊𝒛𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑺𝑸𝑳 𝑸𝒖𝒆𝒓𝒊𝒆𝒔” — distilled from real-world experience, tuning pain points, and best practices.

💡 Whether you’re a data analyst, engineer, or backend developer — this cheat sheet will help you fine-tune your queries and avoid common bottlenecks.
